title: Volatility-managed market: real-time allocation protocol

paper.citation: Cederburg, S., O'Doherty, M., Wang, F. and Yan, X. (2020), On the Performance of Volatility-Managed Portfolios, Journal of Financial Economics.

scope: Curator checklist for a market-only expanding-window allocation analogue, not a reproduction of the paper's 103-strategy study or full robustness grid. The model receives the paper only; it receives neither return data nor this checklist.
claim_review_prompts: Does the card represent the claim as a real-time decision problem rather than an in-sample return comparison?
Does it name the comparison between a volatility-managed opportunity set and a restricted market baseline?
Does it avoid saying that the paper proves volatility management never works?

checklist.label: Use rolling or expanding estimates based only on information available before each decision
Compare the expanded managed-market opportunity set with a restricted unscaled-market baseline
Hold portfolio choice assumptions such as risk aversion and leverage constraints fixed across alternatives
Evaluate economic value with certainty equivalent or an explicit utility criterion, not Sharpe alone
Report uncertainty and cost sensitivity for the incremental allocation outcome
State that an uncertain or cost-negative certainty-equivalent increment would fail the bounded real-time claim
